# Workspace report: `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U`

## 1. Top-level listing

```
drwxr-xr-x  clo-agent-kit/
-rw-r--r--  neoteric_caza-14-11-2025-img (3).zip   (~3.7G)
```

No other top-level items. No `.git` at root. Total ~**4.2G**.

---

## 2. What this workspace is

**Not empty.** It is a **staging / tool workspace**, not an AOSPA source tree.

| Present | Missing |
|--------|---------|
| `clo-agent-kit` — portable CLO/类原生 flash + docs kit for Z60 Ultra | No AOSP/AOSPA `.repo` tree |
| One Neoteric **caza** fastboot image zip | No device trees / `BoardConfig` / `AndroidProducts.mk` |
| Agent handoff notes + hardware docs | No prior ROM build output under this path |

Codename in docs: **cerro** (scripts also say **caza** — same phone). Device: **NX721J / Nubia Z60 Ultra / SM8650**.

Parent project names referenced in kit docs (not present here): `LOA_Nubia_Z60U`, `ArtistAOSP`.

---

## 3. README / notes / manifests / phone-related docs

**Key paths (all under this workspace):**

| Path | Role |
|------|------|
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/README.md` | Kit overview (EDL, AVB-off, what is / isn’t included) |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/AGENT-HANDOFF.md` | Primary agent handoff (USB modes, AVB, flash flow, CLO ROM steps) |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/agent.md` | Hard rules (dual-slot, observe USB, don’t treat Dump as 9008) |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/MANIFEST.txt` | SHA256 inventory; dated `2026-08-24`; device=cerro NX721J SM8650 |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/cerro-hardware.md` | Panel/touch/WiFi/audio/modem hardware facts |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/bootloader-flash-assessment.md` | AVB / eng ABL guidance |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/usb-and-modes-quickref.md` | USB mode quickref |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/docs/servo-flash-clamp.md` | Servo clamp BOM / 9008 entry |
| `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/clo-agent-kit/hardware/servo-flash-clamp/nubia-z60u-clamp-v1.stl` | 3D clamp |

**AOSPA:** folder name only — **no AOSPA docs/manifests/source** inside the tree. Closest ROM artifact is the **Neoteric caza** zip.

**Zip:** `/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U/neoteric_caza-14-11-2025-img (3).zip`  
- Fastboot package: `boot`, `init_boot`, `dtbo`, `recovery`, `vendor_boot`, `vbmeta*`, `system`/`product`/`vendor`/…

| Item | Value |
|------|--------|
| OS | Linux **Evernight Vista 44** (Fedora-like), kernel `7.1.5-kairiki…`, host `evernight` |
| Disk (`/mnt/data`) | **1.6T** total, **~831G free** (47% used) on `/dev/nvme0n1p1` |
| `repo` | Launcher at `/home/rong/bin/repo` (v2.65); not a full installed repo client tree |

| Build basics | `make`, `gcc` present; `clang` not checked as present on PATH in this pass |

Enough for flashing/tools; **not** ready to compile AOSP/AOSPA without installing Java and syncing a source tree elsewhere.

## 5. `clo-agent-kit` — ROM / phone relevance

~**451M** kit. Purpose: **flash / AVB / EDL / observe**, not compile.

**ROM-relevant pieces:**

- **EDL stack:** `tools/edl-tools/edl/` (bkerler), venv already present, Firehose **v1** for Z60:  
  `tools/edl-tools/nubia_sm8650_eng/prog_ufs_firehose_sm8650_v1_ddr.elf`  
  (docs: **do not use v2** on Z60 Ultra)
- **AVB-off images:** `tools/edl-tools/pmos-flash/vbmeta.img`, `vbmeta_system.img`
- **Eng unlock bits (caution):** `tools/edl-tools/nubia_sm8650_eng/eng_v1/` (abl/xbl) — handoff says keep retail XBL/ABL for normal CLO flashing
- **AOSP/CLO flash scripts:**  
  `flash-aosp-fastbootd.sh`, `flash-artistaosp-bootchain-edl.sh`, `flash-infinityx-fastbootd.sh`,  
  `flash-caza-fastbootd.sh` (explicitly for **Neoteric caza** zip/dir — matches the zip in this workspace),  
  `flash-boot-any.sh`, backup/restore roundtrip scripts, `auto-flash-watch.sh` / `auto-observe-boot.sh`
- **USB detect:** `tools/lib/cerro-usb-detect.sh`
- **Servo / unattended 9008:** `tools/agent-phone/`, `enter-9008-hand.sh`
- **Typical CLO flow in `AGENT-HANDOFF.md`:** EDL bootchain → fastbootd → flash `out/.../cerro` (or product name) → ensure AVB off

**Explicitly not in kit:** full partition dumps, AOSP/Debian trees, device-dump, bringup notes like `notes/cerro-linux-bringup.md` (referenced as living on mother repo `LOA_Nubia_Z60U`).

Docs inside the kit mention sibling paths on this machine (e.g. ArtistAOSP backups) — those were **not** inspected per your constraint.

---

### Bottom line

`/mnt/data/AOSPA_Z60U` is a **flash/ops workspace**: clo-agent-kit for **cerro / Z60 Ultra** + a **Neoteric caza** image zip. It is **not** an AOSPA build tree and contains **no device trees**. Disk space on `/mnt/data` is ample; Java is missing for ROM builds.
